propositions: Snapshot-entry schema contract lives in orphaned _snapshot_schema.py, never imported by its intended producer fetcher.py, leaving the declared contract unenforced.
Schema encodes parent presence-vs-absence distinction that gates inbound CLEAR operations; this critical gate has no automated validation coverage.
Snapshot schema is hand-rolled Python module outside the standard schemas.load() / jsonschema / Draft202012Validator machinery that enforces ~90 sibling schemas via CI drift gate.
Real fetcher output fixtures exist in gitignored bridge_state/snapshots/ (548 files, PII-laden) but no redacted, tracked test fixture covers the three observed snapshot-entry shapes.
Moving snapshot contract into src/rebar/schemas/ and generating TypedDict via python -m rebar.schemas.gen_types will integrate it into existing CI drift gate enforcement.
